native: You saw...

en: You know, only NVIDIA's keynote,
zh: 你知道，只有 NVIDIA 的主題演講，

local: You know, only NVIDIA's keynote,
ja_pron: Gozonji no yō ni, NVIDIA no kichō kōen dake ga,
native: You know, only NVIDIA's keynote,

en: will you see last year's slide presented again?

local: will you see last year's slide presented again?
ja_pron: Kyonen no suraido ga futatabi teiji sareru no o miraremasu ka?
native: will you see last year's slide presented again?

en: And the reason for that is I just want to let you know that last year,
zh: 原因是我只是想讓你知道去年，
ja: その理由は、去年のことを皆さんに伝えたいからです。
local: And the reason for that is I just want to let you know that last year,
ja_pron: Sono riyū wa, kyonen no koto o minasan ni tsutaetai kara desu.
native: And the reason for that is I just want to let you know that last year,

en: I told you something very, very important.
zh: 我告訴你一件非常非常重要的事。
ja: 私はとても重要なことを伝えました。
local: I told you something very, very important.
ja_pron: Watashi wa totemo jūyō na koto o tsutaemashita.
native: I told you something very, very important.

en: And it's so important as worthwhile to tell you again.
zh: 這麼重要值得再次告訴你。
ja: それはとても重要なので、もう一度伝える価値があります。
local: And it's so important as worthwhile to tell you again.
ja_pron: Sore wa totemo jūyō nanode, mōichido tsutaeru kachi ga arimasu.
native: And it's so important as worthwhile to tell you again.

en: This is probably the single most important chart for the future of AI factories.
zh: 這可能是 AI 工廠未來最重要的圖表。
ja: これはおそらくAI工場の未来にとって最も重要なチャートです。
local: This is probably the single most important chart for the future of AI factories.
ja_pron: Kore wa osoraku AI kōjō no mirai ni totte mottomo jūyō na chāto desu.
native: This is probably the single most important chart for the future of AI factories.

en: And every CEO in the world will be tracking it.
zh: 全世界的每位執行長都會追蹤它。
ja: 世界中のすべてのCEOがこれを追跡するでしょう。
local: And every CEO in the world will be tracking it.
ja_pron: Sekaijū no subete no CEO ga kore o tsuiseki suru deshō.
native: And every CEO in the world will be tracking it.

en: We'll be studying it very deeply.
zh: 我們會非常深入地研究它。
ja: 私たちはこれを非常に深く研究します。
local: We'll be studying it very deeply.
ja_pron: Watashitachi wa kore o hijō ni fukaku kenkyū shimasu.
native: We'll be studying it very deeply.

en: It's much, much more complicated than this.
zh: 它比這複雜得多。
ja: これはこれよりもずっと複雑です。
local: It's much, much more complicated than this.
ja_pron: Kore wa kore yori mo zutto fukuzatsu desu.
native: It's much, much more complicated than this.

en: It's multidimensional.
zh: 它是多維度的。
ja: それは多次元的です。
local: It's multidimensional.
ja_pron: Sore wa tajigen-teki desu.
native: It's multidimensional.

en: But you'll be studying the throughput and the token speed of your AI factories.
zh: 但你會研究你 AI 工廠的吞吐量和令牌速度。
ja: しかし、あなたはAI工場のスループットとトークンスピードを研究するでしょう。
local: But you'll be studying the throughput and the token speed of your AI factories.
ja_pron: Shikashi, anata wa AI kōjō no surūputto to tōkun supīdo o kenkyū suru deshō.
native: But you'll be studying the throughput and the token speed of your AI factories.

en: The throughput token speed at ISO power,
zh: 在 ISO 功率下的吞吐量和令牌速度，
ja: ISOパワーでのスループットとトークンスピード、
local: The throughput token speed at ISO power,
ja_pron: ISO pawā de no surūputto to tōkun supīdo,
native: The throughput token speed at ISO power,

en: because that's all the power you have, throughput and token speed for your factories forever.
zh: 因為那就是你擁有的全部能力，工廠的吞吐量和令牌速度將永遠如此。
ja: なぜなら、それがあなたの持つ全ての力であり、工場のスループットとトークンスピードが永遠に続くからです。
local: because that's all the power you have, throughput and token speed for your factories forever.
ja_pron: Nazenara, sore ga anata no motsu subete no chikara de ari, kōjō no surūputto to tōkonsupīdo ga eien ni tsuzuku kara desu.
native: because that's all the power you have, throughput and token speed for your factories forever.

en: And that analysis is going to lead directly to your revenues.
zh: 而這個分析將直接導向你的收入。
ja: そしてその分析は、あなたの収益に直接つながります。
local: And that analysis is going to lead directly to your revenues.
ja_pron: Soshite sono bunseki wa, anata no shūeki ni chokusetsu tsunagarimasu.
native: And that analysis is going to lead directly to your revenues.

en: What you do this year will show up precisely next year as your revenues.
zh: 你今年所做的事情，明年將準確地反映為你的收入。
ja: 今年あなたが行うことは、来年正確に収益として現れます。
local: What you do this year will show up precisely next year as your revenues.
ja_pron: Kotoshi anata ga okonau koto wa, rainen seikaku ni shūeki to shite arawaremasu.
native: What you do this year will show up precisely next year as your revenues.

en: And this chart is what it's all about.
zh: 而這張圖表就是重點所在。
ja: そしてこのチャートが全ての要点です。
local: And this chart is what it's all about.
ja_pron: Soshite kono chāto ga subete no yōten desu.
native: And this chart is what it's all about.

en: And I said, on the vertical axis, on the vertical axis,
zh: 我說過，在縱軸上，在縱軸上，
ja: そして私は言いました、縦軸に、縦軸に、
local: And I said, on the vertical axis, on the vertical axis,
ja_pron: Soshite watashi wa iimashita, tatejiku ni, tatejiku ni,
native: And I said, on the vertical axis, on the vertical axis,

en: thank you guys, on the vertical axis is throughput.
zh: 謝謝大家，縱軸是吞吐量。
ja: みなさんありがとう、縦軸はスループットです。
local: thank you guys, on the vertical axis is throughput.
ja_pron: Minasan arigatō, tatejiku wa surūputto desu.
native: thank you guys, on the vertical axis is throughput.

en: On the horizontal axis is token rate.
zh: 橫軸是令牌速率。
ja: 横軸はトークンレートです。
local: On the horizontal axis is token rate.
ja_pron: Yoko jiku wa tōkun rēto desu.
native: On the horizontal axis is token rate.

en: Today, I'm going to show you this.
zh: 今天，我將向你展示這個。
ja: 今日はこれをお見せします。
local: Today, I'm going to show you this.
ja_pron: Kyō wa kore o omise shimasu.
native: Today, I'm going to show you this.

en: Because we're able, because we're now able to increase the token speed,
zh: 因為我們現在能夠提高令牌速度，
ja: なぜなら、私たちは今、トークンスピードを上げることができるからです。
local: Because we're able, because we're now able to increase the token speed,
ja_pron: Nazenara, watashitachi wa ima, tōkun supīdo o ageru koto ga dekiru kara desu.
native: Because we're able, because we're now able to increase the token speed,

en: and because model sizes are increasing,
zh: 而且模型大小也在增加，
ja: そしてモデルサイズが増加しているからです。
local: and because model sizes are increasing,
ja_pron: Soshite moderu saizu ga zōka shite iru kara desu.
native: and because model sizes are increasing,

en: because the token length, the context length, depending on the different grades of different application use case,
zh: 因為令牌長度、上下文長度，依不同應用案例的等級而異，
ja: トークンの長さ、コンテキストの長さは、異なるアプリケーションの使用ケースのグレードによって異なるからです。
local: because the token length, the context length, depending on the different grades of different application use case,
ja_pron: Tōkun no nagasa, kontekisuto no nagasa wa, kotonaru apurikeeshon no shiyō kēsu no gurēdo ni yotte kotonaru kara desu.
native: because the token length, the context length, depending on the different grades of different application use case,

en: continues to grow from maybe 100,000 tokens input length to maybe millions.
zh: 持續從大約10萬令牌的輸入長度成長到可能是數百萬。
ja: 入力長さが約10万トークンから数百万にまで成長し続けています。
local: continues to grow from maybe 100,000 tokens input length to maybe millions.
ja_pron: Nyūryoku nagasa ga yaku 10-man tōkun kara sūhyakuman ni made seichō shi tsuzuketeimasu.
native: continues to grow from maybe 100,000 tokens input length to maybe millions.

en: The token input length is growing, and also the output token length is growing.
zh: 令牌輸入長度在增加，輸出令牌長度也在增加。
ja: トークンの入力長さが増加しており、出力トークンの長さも増加しています。
local: The token input length is growing, and also the output token length is growing.
ja_pron: Tōkun no nyūryoku nagasa ga zōka shite ori, shutsuryoku tōkun no nagasa mo zōka shiteimasu.
native: The token input length is growing, and also the output token length is growing.

en: And so all of these play into ultimately the marketing and the pricing of future tokens.
zh: 因此，這些因素最終會影響未來令牌的行銷和定價。
ja: これらすべてが最終的に将来のトークンのマーケティングと価格設定に影響します。
local: And so all of these play into ultimately the marketing and the pricing of future tokens.
ja_pron: Korera subete ga saishūteki ni shōrai no tōkun no māketingu to kakaku settei ni eikyō shimasu.
native: And so all of these play into ultimately the marketing and the pricing of future tokens.

en: Tokens are the new commodity.
zh: 令牌是新的商品。
ja: トークンは新しい商品です。
local: Tokens are the new commodity.
ja_pron: Tōkun wa atarashii shōhin desu.
native: Tokens are the new commodity.

en: And like all commodities, once it reaches an inflection, once it becomes mature,
zh: 就像所有商品一樣，一旦達到轉折點，一旦成熟，
ja: すべての商品と同様に、転換点に達し、成熟すると、
local: And like all commodities, once it reaches an inflection, once it becomes mature,
ja_pron: Subete no shōhin to dōyō ni, tenkan ten ni tasshi, seijuku suru to,
native: And like all commodities, once it reaches an inflection, once it becomes mature,

en: or it becomes maturing, it will segment into different parts.
zh: 或是正在成熟，它會分割成不同部分。
ja: または成熟しつつあるとき、それは異なる部分に分割されます。
local: or it becomes maturing, it will segment into different parts.
ja_pron: Mata wa seijuku shitsutsu aru toki, sore wa kotonaru bubun ni bunkatsu saremasu.
native: or it becomes maturing, it will segment into different parts.

en: The high throughput, low speed, could be used for the free tier.
zh: 高吞吐量、低速度的部分，可以用於免費等級。
ja: 高スループットで低速のものは無料ティアに使われるかもしれません。
local: The high throughput, low speed, could be used for the free tier.
ja_pron: Kō surūputto de teisoku no mono wa muryō tia ni tsukawareru kamoshiremasen.
native: The high throughput, low speed, could be used for the free tier.

en: The next tier could be the medium tier.
zh: 下一個等級可能是中等級。
ja: 次のティアは中間ティアかもしれません。
local: The next tier could be the medium tier.
ja_pron: Tsugi no tia wa chūkan tia kamoshiremasen.
native: The next tier could be the medium tier.

en: Larger model maybe, higher speed for sure, larger input context length.
zh: 可能是更大的模型，速度更快，輸入上下文長度更大。
ja: より大きなモデルで、確かに速度も速く、入力コンテキストの長さも大きいです。
local: Larger model maybe, higher speed for sure, larger input context length.
ja_pron: Yori ōkina moderu de, tashika ni sokudo mo hayaku, nyūryoku konte kisuto no nagasa mo ōkii desu.
native: Larger model maybe, higher speed for sure, larger input context length.

en: That translates to a different price point.
zh: 這轉化為不同的價格點。
ja: それは異なる価格帯に変換されます。
local: That translates to a different price point.
ja_pron: Sore wa kotonaru kakakutai ni henkan saremasu.
native: That translates to a different price point.

en: You could see from all the different services, this one is free.
zh: 你可以從所有不同的服務中看到，這個是免費的。
ja: さまざまなサービスからこれが無料であることがわかります。
local: You could see from all the different services, this one is free.
ja_pron: Samazama na sābisu kara kore ga muryō de aru koto ga wakarimasu.
native: You could see from all the different services, this one is free.

en: it's a free tier.
zh: 這是免費等級。
ja: これは無料ティアです。
local: it's a free tier.
ja_pron: Kore wa muryō tia desu.
native: it's a free tier.

en: The first tier could be $3 per million tokens.
zh: 第一個等級可能是每百萬令牌3美元。
ja: 最初のティアは100万トークンあたり3ドルかもしれません。
local: The first tier could be $3 per million tokens.
ja_pron: Saisho no tia wa 100-man tōkun atari 3 doru kamoshiremasen.
native: The first tier could be $3 per million tokens.

en: The next tier could be $6 per million tokens.
zh: 下一個等級可能是每百萬令牌6美元。
ja: 次のティアは100万トークンあたり6ドルかもしれません。
local: The next tier could be $6 per million tokens.
ja_pron: Tsugi no tia wa 100-man tōkun atari 6 doru kamoshiremasen.
native: The next tier could be $6 per million tokens.

en: You would like to be able to keep pushing this boundary, because the larger the model, smarter,
zh: 你會想持續推進這個界限，因為模型越大越聰明，
ja: この境界を押し続けたいでしょう。モデルが大きくなるほど賢くなりますから。
local: You would like to be able to keep pushing this boundary, because the larger the model, smarter,
ja_pron: Kono kyōkai o oshitsuzuketai deshō. Moderu ga ōkiku naru hodo kashikoku narimasu kara.
native: You would like to be able to keep pushing this boundary, because the larger the model, smarter,

en: the more input token context length, more relevant, the higher the speed,
zh: 輸入令牌上下文長度越長，越相關，速度越快，
ja: 入力トークンのコンテキスト長が長くなり、より関連性が高く、速度も速くなります。
local: the more input token context length, more relevant, the higher the speed,
ja_pron: Nyūryoku tōkun no konte kisuto nagasa ga nagaku nari, yori kanrensei ga takaku, sokudo mo hayaku narimasu.
native: the more input token context length, more relevant, the higher the speed,

en: the more you can think and iterate smarter AI models.
zh: 你就能更好地思考和迭代更聰明的 AI 模型。
ja: より賢いAIモデルを考え、繰り返し改善することができます。
local: the more you can think and iterate smarter AI models.
ja_pron: Yori kashikoi AI moderu o kangae, kurikaeshi kaizen suru koto ga dekimasu.
native: the more you can think and iterate smarter AI models.

en: So this is about smarter AI models.
zh: 所以這是關於更聰明的 AI 模型。
ja: つまり、これはより賢いAIモデルについてです。
local: So this is about smarter AI models.
ja_pron: Tsumari, kore wa yori kashikoi AI moderu ni tsuite desu.
native: So this is about smarter AI models.

en: And when you have smarter AI models, each one of these clicks allows you to increase the price.
zh: 當你擁有更聰明的 AI 模型時，每一次這樣的提升都能讓你提高價格。
ja: そして、より賢いAIモデルを持つと、これらのクリックの一つ一つが価格を上げることを可能にします。
local: And when you have smarter AI models, each one of these clicks allows you to increase the price.
ja_pron: Soshite, yori kashikoi AI moderu o motsu to, korera no kurikku no hitotsu hitotsu ga kakaku o ageru koto o kanō ni shimasu.
native: And when you have smarter AI models, each one of these clicks allows you to increase the price.

en: So this is $45.
zh: 所以這是 45 美元。
ja: これは45ドルです。
local: So this is $45.
ja_pron: Kore wa 45 doru desu.
native: So this is $45.

en: And maybe one day, there will be a premium model that allows you, a premium service,
zh: 也許有一天，會有一個高級模型，提供你高級服務，
ja: そしていつか、プレミアムモデルが登場し、プレミアムサービスを提供するでしょう。
local: And maybe one day, there will be a premium model that allows you, a premium service,
ja_pron: Soshite itsuka, puremiamu moderu ga tōjō shi, puremiamu sābisu o teikyō suru deshō.
native: And maybe one day, there will be a premium model that allows you, a premium service,

en: that allows you to generate token speeds that are incredibly high,
zh: 讓你產生極高的令牌速度，
ja: 信じられないほど高速なトークンスピードを生み出すことができる、
local: that allows you to generate token speeds that are incredibly high,
ja_pron: Shinjirarenai hodo kōsoku na tōkun supīdo o umidasu koto ga dekiru,
native: that allows you to generate token speeds that are incredibly high,

en: because you're in a critical path, or maybe you're doing really long research,
zh: 因為你處於關鍵路徑，或者你正在進行非常長時間的研究，
ja: なぜならあなたは重要な経路にいるか、非常に長い研究をしているかもしれないからです。
local: because you're in a critical path, or maybe you're doing really long research,
ja_pron: Nazenara anata wa jūyō na keiro ni iru ka, hijō ni nagai kenkyū o shite iru kamoshirenai kara desu.
native: because you're in a critical path, or maybe you're doing really long research,

en: and $150 per million tokens is just not a thing.
zh: 而每百萬令牌150美元根本不是問題。
ja: そして100万トークンあたり150ドルは問題ではありません。
local: and $150 per million tokens is just not a thing.
ja_pron: Soshite 100-man tōkun atari 150 doru wa mondai de wa arimasen.
native: and $150 per million tokens is just not a thing.

en: So let's translate that.
zh: 所以讓我們換算一下。
ja: では、それを換算してみましょう。
local: So let's translate that.
ja_pron: Dewa, sore o kansan shite mimashō.
native: So let's translate that.

en: Suppose you were to use 50 million tokens per day as a researcher,
zh: 假設你作為研究人員每天使用五千萬令牌，
ja: 研究者として1日に5000万トークンを使用すると仮定しましょう。
local: Suppose you were to use 50 million tokens per day as a researcher,
ja_pron: Kenkyūsha to shite ichi-nichi ni 5000-man tōkun o shiyō suru to katei shimashō.
native: Suppose you were to use 50 million tokens per day as a researcher,

en: at $150 per million tokens.
zh: 以每百萬令牌150美元計算。
ja: 100万トークンあたり150ドルで。
local: at $150 per million tokens.
ja_pron: 100-man tōkun atari 150 doru de.
native: at $150 per million tokens.

zh: 我們在其上運行Dynamo，這個令人難以置信的AI工廠操作系統，
ja: その上で、AI工場向けの驚異的なオペレーティングシステムDynamoを実行します。
local: We run Dynamo, this incredible operating system for AI factories on top of it,
ja_pron: Sono ue de, AI kōjō-muke no kyōi-teki na operētingu shisutemu Dynamo o jikkō shimasu.
native: We run Dynamo, this incredible operating system for AI factories on top of it,

en: and you get 35 times increase, 35 times increase,
zh: 你會得到35倍的提升，35倍的提升，
ja: そして35倍の性能向上が得られます、35倍の性能向上です。
local: and you get 35 times increase, 35 times increase,
ja_pron: Soshite 35-bai no seinō kōjō ga eraremasu, 35-bai no seinō kōjō desu.
native: and you get 35 times increase, 35 times increase,

en: not to mention additional new tiers of inference performance
zh: 更不用說額外新增的推理性能層級，
ja: さらに、新たな推論性能の階層も加わります。
local: not to mention additional new tiers of inference performance
ja_pron: Sara ni, aratana suiron seinō no kaisō mo kuwawarimasu.
native: not to mention additional new tiers of inference performance

en: for token generation the world's never seen.
zh: 這是世界前所未見的標記生成性能。
ja: 世界がこれまで見たことのないトークン生成性能です。
local: for token generation the world's never seen.
ja_pron: Sekai ga kore made mita koto no nai tōkun seisei seinō desu.
native: for token generation the world's never seen.

en: So this is it, this is GROC.
zh: 這就是GROC。
ja: これがGROCです。
local: So this is it, this is GROC.
ja_pron: Kore ga GROC desu.
native: So this is it, this is GROC.

en: The Vera Rubin systems, including GROC,
zh: 包括GROC在內的Vera Rubin系統，
ja: GROCを含むVera Rubinシステムは、
local: The Vera Rubin systems, including GROC,
ja_pron: GROC o fukumu Vera Rubin shisutemu wa,
native: The Vera Rubin systems, including GROC,

en: I want to thank Samsung, who manufactures the GROC LP30 chip for us,
zh: 我要感謝為我們製造GROC LP30晶片的三星，
ja: GROC LP30チップを製造してくれるサムスンに感謝します。
local: I want to thank Samsung, who manufactures the GROC LP30 chip for us,
ja_pron: GROC LP30 chippu o seizō shite kureru Samusun ni kansha shimasu.
native: I want to thank Samsung, who manufactures the GROC LP30 chip for us,

en: and they're cranking as hard as they can.
zh: 他們正在全力以赴地努力。
ja: 彼らは全力で取り組んでいます。
local: and they're cranking as hard as they can.
ja_pron: Karera wa zenryoku de torikunde imasu.
native: and they're cranking as hard as they can.

en: I really appreciate you guys, we're in production with the GROC chip,
zh: 我非常感謝你們，我們已經開始生產GROC晶片，
ja: 本当に感謝しています。GROCチップの生産が始まっています。
local: I really appreciate you guys, we're in production with the GROC chip,
ja_pron: Hontō ni kansha shiteimasu. GROC chippu no seisan ga hajimatte imasu.
native: I really appreciate you guys, we're in production with the GROC chip,

en: and we'll ship it in the second half, probably about Q3 timeframe.
zh: 我們將在下半年出貨，可能大約在第三季。
ja: 後半期、たぶん第3四半期に出荷します。
local: and we'll ship it in the second half, probably about Q3 timeframe.
ja_pron: Kōhanki, tabun dai 3 shihanki ni shukka shimasu.
native: and we'll ship it in the second half, probably about Q3 timeframe.

en: Okay?
zh: 好嗎？
ja: いいですか？
local: Okay?
ja_pron: Ii desu ka?
native: Okay?

en: GROC LPX.
zh: GROC LPX。
ja: GROC LPX。
local: GROC LPX.
ja_pron: GROC LPX.
native: GROC LPX.

en: Vera Rubin, it's kind of hard to imagine any more customers.
zh: Vera Rubin，很難想像還會有更多客戶。
ja: Vera Rubin、これ以上の顧客を想像するのは難しいです。
local: Vera Rubin, it's kind of hard to imagine any more customers.
ja_pron: Vera Rubin, kore ijō no kokyaku o sōzō suru no wa muzukashii desu.
native: Vera Rubin, it's kind of hard to imagine any more customers.

en: You know, and the really great thing is Grace Blackwell,
zh: 你知道，真正棒的是Grace Blackwell，
ja: ご存知のように、本当に素晴らしいのはGrace Blackwellです、
local: You know, and the really great thing is Grace Blackwell,
ja_pron: Gozonji no yō ni, hontō ni subarashii no wa Grace Blackwell desu,
native: You know, and the really great thing is Grace Blackwell,

en: early sampling of it, was really complicated because of coming together
zh: 早期取樣非常複雜，因為它們是結合在一起的，
ja: 初期サンプリングは、本当に複雑でした。なぜなら結合していたからです、
local: early sampling of it, was really complicated because of coming together
ja_pron: Shoki sanpuringu wa, hontō ni fukuzatsu deshita. Nazenara ketsugō shite ita kara desu,
native: early sampling of it, was really complicated because of coming together

en: and being linked 72.
zh: 並且連結了72個。
ja: そして72個にリンクされていました。
local: and being linked 72.
ja_pron: Soshite 72-ko ni rinku sarete imashita.
native: and being linked 72.

en: But the sampling of Vera Rubin is just going incredibly well.
zh: 但Vera Rubin的取樣進展非常順利。
ja: しかし、Vera Rubinのサンプリングは非常に順調に進んでいます。
local: But the sampling of Vera Rubin is just going incredibly well.
ja_pron: Shikashi, Vera Rubin no sanpuringu wa hijō ni junchō ni susunde imasu.
native: But the sampling of Vera Rubin is just going incredibly well.

en: And in fact, Satya, I think, texted out already that the first Vera Rubin rack
zh: 事實上，我想Satya已經發訊息說第一台Vera Rubin機架
ja: 実際、Satyaはすでに最初のVera Rubinラックが
local: And in fact, Satya, I think, texted out already that the first Vera Rubin rack
ja_pron: Jissai, Satya wa sudeni saisho no Vera Rubin rakku ga
native: And in fact, Satya, I think, texted out already that the first Vera Rubin rack

en: is already up and running at Microsoft Azure, and so I'm super excited for them.
zh: 已經在Microsoft Azure上運行了，所以我非常為他們感到興奮。
ja: すでにMicrosoft Azureで稼働しており、彼らのためにとても興奮しています。
local: is already up and running at Microsoft Azure, and so I'm super excited for them.
ja_pron: Sudeni Microsoft Azure de kadō shite ori, karera no tame ni totemo kōfun shite imasu.
native: is already up and running at Microsoft Azure, and so I'm super excited for them.

en: We're going to keep cranking these things out.
zh: 我們將繼續大量生產這些設備。
ja: これらの機器をどんどん生産し続けます。
local: We're going to keep cranking these things out.
ja_pron: Korera no kiki o dondon seisan shi tsuzukemasu.
native: We're going to keep cranking these things out.

en: We have now set up a supply chain that could manufacture thousands a week of these systems,
zh: 我們現在建立了一條供應鏈，每週可製造數千台這些系統，
ja: 現在、これらのシステムを週に数千台製造できるサプライチェーンを構築しました。
local: We have now set up a supply chain that could manufacture thousands a week of these systems,
ja_pron: Genzai, korera no shisutemu o shū ni sūsen-dai seizō dekiru sapurai chēn o kōchiku shimashita.
native: We have now set up a supply chain that could manufacture thousands a week of these systems,

en: essentially multi-gigawatts of AI factories per month inside our supply chain.
zh: 基本上，我們的供應鏈每月能生產數百萬瓦特的AI工廠。
ja: 実質的に、私たちのサプライチェーン内で毎月数ギガワットのAI工場を生産しています。
local: essentially multi-gigawatts of AI factories per month inside our supply chain.
ja_pron: Jisshitsuteki ni, watashitachi no sapurai chēn-nai de maitsuki sū gigawatto no AI kōjō o seisan shiteimasu.
native: essentially multi-gigawatts of AI factories per month inside our supply chain.

en: And so we're going to crank out these Vera Rubin racks while we're cranking out the GB300 racks.
zh: 所以我們將在生產GB300機架的同時大量生產這些Vera Rubin機架。
ja: ですから、GB300ラックを生産しながら、これらのVera Rubinラックも大量生産します。
local: And so we're going to crank out these Vera Rubin racks while we're cranking out the GB300 racks.
ja_pron: Desu kara, GB300 rakku o seisan shinagara, korera no Vera Rubin rakku mo tairyo seisan shimasu.
native: And so we're going to crank out these Vera Rubin racks while we're cranking out the GB300 racks.

en: We are in full production.
zh: 我們已全面投產。
ja: 私たちは本格的に生産しています。
local: We are in full production.
ja_pron: Watashitachi wa honkakuteki ni seisan shiteimasu.
native: We are in full production.

en: The Vera CPUs, incredibly successful, and the reason for that is because AI needs CPUs for tool use.
zh: Vera CPU非常成功，原因是AI需要CPU來使用工具。
ja: Vera CPUは非常に成功しています。その理由は、AIがツール使用にCPUを必要とするからです。
local: The Vera CPUs, incredibly successful, and the reason for that is because AI needs CPUs for tool use.
ja_pron: Vera CPU wa hijō ni seikō shiteimasu. Sono riyū wa, AI ga tsūru shiyō ni CPU o hitsuyō to suru kara desu.
native: The Vera CPUs, incredibly successful, and the reason for that is because AI needs CPUs for tool use.

en: And Vera CPU was designed just perfectly for that sweet spot,
zh: Vera CPU正是為這個黃金點完美設計，
ja: そしてVera CPUは、その絶妙なポイントのために完璧に設計されました。
local: And Vera CPU was designed just perfectly for that sweet spot,
ja_pron: Soshite Vera CPU wa, sono zetsumyō na pointo no tame ni kanpeki ni sekkei saremashita.
native: And Vera CPU was designed just perfectly for that sweet spot,

en: incredible for the next generation of data processing.
zh: 對下一代數據處理來說非常出色。
ja: 次世代のデータ処理にとって素晴らしいものです。
local: incredible for the next generation of data processing.
ja_pron: Jisedai no dēta shori ni totte subarashī mono desu.
native: incredible for the next generation of data processing.

en: Vera CPU is ideal.
zh: Vera CPU是理想的。
ja: Vera CPUは理想的です。
local: Vera CPU is ideal.
ja_pron: Vera CPU wa risō-teki desu.
native: Vera CPU is ideal.

en: The Vera CPU plus CX9 connected into the Bluefield Force DAC.
zh: Vera CPU加上連接到Bluefield Force DAC的CX9。
ja: Vera CPUとCX9がBluefield Force DACに接続されています。
local: The Vera CPU plus CX9 connected into the Bluefield Force DAC.
ja_pron: Vera CPU to CX9 ga Bluefield Force DAC ni setsuzoku sarete imasu.
native: The Vera CPU plus CX9 connected into the Bluefield Force DAC.

en: 100% of the world's storage industry is joining us on this system.
zh: 全球100%的儲存產業都加入了這個系統。
ja: 世界のストレージ業界の100％がこのシステムに参加しています。
local: 100% of the world's storage industry is joining us on this system.
ja_pron: Sekai no storēji gyōkai no 100-pāsento ga kono shisutemu ni sanka shiteimasu.
native: 100% of the world's storage industry is joining us on this system.

en: And the reason for that is because they see exactly the same thing.
zh: 原因是他們看到完全相同的情況。
ja: その理由は、彼らがまったく同じものを見ているからです。
local: And the reason for that is because they see exactly the same thing.
ja_pron: Sono riyū wa, karera ga mattaku onaji mono o mite iru kara desu.
native: And the reason for that is because they see exactly the same thing.

en: The storage system is going to get pounded.
zh: 儲存系統將會被重度使用。
ja: ストレージシステムは酷使されるでしょう。
local: The storage system is going to get pounded.
ja_pron: Storēji shisutemu wa kokushi sareru deshō.
native: The storage system is going to get pounded.

en: It's going to get pounded because we used to have humans using the storage systems.
zh: 這將被重度使用，因為過去是人類使用儲存系統。
ja: 人間がストレージシステムを使っていたため、酷使されることになります。
local: It's going to get pounded because we used to have humans using the storage systems.
ja_pron: Ningen ga storēji shisutemu o tsukatte ita tame, kokushi sareru koto ni narimasu.
native: It's going to get pounded because we used to have humans using the storage systems.

en: We used to have humans using SQL.
zh: 我們過去是人類使用SQL。
ja: 以前は人間がSQLを使っていました。
local: We used to have humans using SQL.
ja_pron: Izen wa ningen ga SQL o tsukatte imashita.
native: We used to have humans using SQL.

en: Now we're going to have AI's using these storage systems.
zh: 現在將由AI使用這些儲存系統。
ja: 今度はAIがこれらのストレージシステムを使うことになります。
local: Now we're going to have AI's using these storage systems.
ja_pron: Kondo wa AI ga korera no storēji shisutemu o tsukau koto ni narimasu.
native: Now we're going to have AI's using these storage systems.

en: And this is going to store QDF accelerated storage.
zh: 這將存儲QDF加速儲存。
ja: そして、これはQDF加速ストレージを保存します。
local: And this is going to store QDF accelerated storage.
ja_pron: Soshite, kore wa QDF kasoku storēji o hozon shimasu.
native: And this is going to store QDF accelerated storage.

en: QVS accelerated storage as well as very importantly, KV caching.
zh: QVS加速儲存，以及非常重要的KV快取。
ja: QVS加速ストレージと非常に重要なKVキャッシュも含みます。
local: QVS accelerated storage as well as very importantly, KV caching.
ja_pron: QVS kasoku storēji to hijō ni jūyō na KV kyasshu mo fukumimasu.
native: QVS accelerated storage as well as very importantly, KV caching.

en: Okay, so this is the Vera Rubin system.
zh: 好的，這就是Vera Rubin系統。
ja: はい、これがVera Rubinシステムです。
local: Okay, so this is the Vera Rubin system.
ja_pron: Hai, kore ga Vera Rubin shisutemu desu.
native: Okay, so this is the Vera Rubin system.

en: Now what's amazing is this.
zh: 現在令人驚奇的是這個。
ja: 今、驚くべきことはこれです。
local: Now what's amazing is this.
ja_pron: Ima, odorokubeki koto wa kore desu.
native: Now what's amazing is this.

en: In just two years time, in a one gigawatt factory.
zh: 僅在兩年內，在一個一吉瓦工廠中。
ja: わずか2年で、1ギガワットの工場で。
local: In just two years time, in a one gigawatt factory.
ja_pron: Wazuka 2-nen de, 1 gigawatto no kōjō de.
native: In just two years time, in a one gigawatt factory.

en: In just two years time, in one gigawatt factory.
zh: 僅在兩年內，在一個一吉瓦工廠中。
ja: わずか2年で、1ギガワットの工場で。
local: In just two years time, in one gigawatt factory.
ja_pron: Wazuka 2-nen de, 1 gigawatto no kōjō de.
native: In just two years time, in one gigawatt factory.

en: Using the mathematics that I showed you earlier.
zh: 使用我之前展示給你的數學方法。
ja: 先ほどお見せした数学を使って。
local: Using the mathematics that I showed you earlier.
ja_pron: Sakihodo o miseta sūgaku o tsukatte.
native: Using the mathematics that I showed you earlier.

en: We asked Moore's Law, would have given us a couple of steps.
zh: 我們問摩爾定律，會給我們幾個步驟。
ja: ムーアの法則に尋ねたら、いくつかのステップを与えてくれたでしょう。
local: We asked Moore's Law, would have given us a couple of steps.
ja_pron: Mūa no hōsoku ni tazunetara, ikutsu ka no suteppu o ataete kureta deshō.
native: We asked Moore's Law, would have given us a couple of steps.

en: We would have, you know, x-factored the number of transistors.
zh: 我們會對晶體管數量進行指數增長。
ja: トランジスタの数を指数関数的に増やしたでしょう。
local: We would have, you know, x-factored the number of transistors.
ja_pron: Toranjisuta no kazu o shisū kansū-teki ni fuyashita deshō.
native: We would have, you know, x-factored the number of transistors.

en: We would have x-factored the number of flops.
zh: 我們會對浮點運算次數進行指數增長。
ja: フロップ数も指数関数的に増やしたでしょう。
local: We would have x-factored the number of flops.
ja_pron: Furoppu sū mo shisū kansū-teki ni fuyashita deshō.
native: We would have x-factored the number of flops.

en: We would have x-factored the number of amount of bandwidth.
zh: 我們會對帶寬量進行指數增長。
ja: 帯域幅の量も指数関数的に増やしたでしょう。
local: We would have x-factored the number of amount of bandwidth.
ja_pron: Taiikihaba no ryō mo shisū kansū-teki ni fuyashita deshō.
native: We would have x-factored the number of amount of bandwidth.

en: But with this architecture, we're going to take our token generation speed.
zh: 但有了這個架構，我們將提升標記生成速度。
ja: しかし、このアーキテクチャで、トークン生成速度を向上させます。
local: But with this architecture, we're going to take our token generation speed.
ja_pron: Shikashi, kono ākitekucha de, tōkun seisei sokudo o kōjō sasemasu.
native: But with this architecture, we're going to take our token generation speed.

en: Token generation rate from 2 million to 700 million, 350 times increase.
zh: 標記生成率從200萬提升到7億，增長350倍。
ja: トークン生成速度を200万から7億へ、350倍に増加させます。
local: Token generation rate from 2 million to 700 million, 350 times increase.
ja_pron: Tōkun seisei sokudo o 200-man kara 7-oku e, 350-bai ni zōka sasemasu.
native: Token generation rate from 2 million to 700 million, 350 times increase.

en: This is the power of extreme code design.
zh: 這就是極端代碼設計的力量。
ja: これが極端なコード設計の力です。
local: This is the power of extreme code design.
ja_pron: Kore ga kyokutan na kōdo sekkei no chikara desu.
native: This is the power of extreme code design.

en: This is what I mean when we integrate and optimize vertically.
zh: 這就是我說的垂直整合與優化。
ja: これが私が言う垂直統合と最適化の意味です。
local: This is what I mean when we integrate and optimize vertically.
ja_pron: Kore ga watashi ga iu suichoku tōgō to saiteki-ka no imi desu.
native: This is what I mean when we integrate and optimize vertically.

en: But then we open it horizontally for everybody to enjoy.
zh: 但我們也橫向開放，讓所有人都能享受。
ja: しかし、それを横方向に開放して、誰もが利用できるようにします。
local: But then we open it horizontally for everybody to enjoy.
ja_pron: Shikashi, sore o yokohōkō ni kaikō shite, dare mo ga riyō dekiru yō ni shimasu.
native: But then we open it horizontally for everybody to enjoy.

en: This is our roadmap very quickly.
zh: 這是我們的快速路線圖。
ja: これが私たちのロードマップです。
local: This is our roadmap very quickly.
ja_pron: Kore ga watashitachi no rōdomappu desu.
native: This is our roadmap very quickly.

en: Blackwell is here, the Oberon system.
zh: Blackwell在這裡，Oberon系統。
ja: Blackwellがここにあり、Oberonシステムです。
local: Blackwell is here, the Oberon system.
ja_pron: Blackwell ga koko ni ari, Oberon shisutemu desu.
native: Blackwell is here, the Oberon system.

en: In the case of Rubin, we have the Oberon system.
zh: 在Rubin的情況下，我們有Oberon系統。
ja: Rubinの場合、私たちはOberonシステムを持っています。
local: In the case of Rubin, we have the Oberon system.
ja_pron: Rubin no baai, watashitachi wa Oberon shisutemu o motte imasu.
native: In the case of Rubin, we have the Oberon system.

en: We're always backwards compatible so that if you wanted to not change anything
zh: 我們始終向後相容，因此如果你不想改變任何東西，
ja: 私たちは常に後方互換性を保っているので、何も変更したくない場合でも、
local: We're always backwards compatible so that if you wanted to not change anything
ja_pron: Watashitachi wa tsuneni kōhō gokansei o tamotte iru node, nanimo henkō shitakunai baai demo,
native: We're always backwards compatible so that if you wanted to not change anything

en: and just keep on moving through with the new architecture, you could do so.
zh: 並且繼續使用新架構，你可以這麼做。
ja: 新しいアーキテクチャを使い続けることができます。
local: and just keep on moving through with the new architecture, you could do so.
ja_pron: Atarashii ākitekucha o tsukai tsuzukeru koto ga dekimasu.
native: and just keep on moving through with the new architecture, you could do so.

en: The old system, the standard rack system Oberon still available.
zh: 舊系統，標準機架系統 Oberon 仍然可用。
ja: 旧システムである標準ラックシステムのOberonはまだ利用可能です。
local: The old system, the standard rack system Oberon still available.
native: The old system, the standard rack system Oberon still available.

en: Oberon is copper scale up.
zh: Oberon 是銅線擴展。
ja: Oberonは銅ケーブルによるスケールアップです。
local: Oberon is copper scale up.
native: Oberon is copper scale up.

en: With Oberon, we could also use optical scale up to expand to NVLink 576.
zh: 使用 Oberon，我們也可以使用光學擴展來擴展到 NVLink 576。
ja: Oberonを使うことで、光学スケールアップを利用してNVLink 576まで拡張できます。
local: With Oberon, we could also use optical scale up to expand to NVLink 576.
native: With Oberon, we could also use optical scale up to expand to NVLink 576.

en: There's a lot of conversation about is NVidia going to copper scale up or optical scale up?
zh: 有很多討論關於 NVidia 是會使用銅線擴展還是光學擴展？
ja: NVidiaが銅ケーブルによるスケールアップか光学スケールアップのどちらを採用するのか、多くの議論があります。
local: There's a lot of conversation about is NVidia going to copper scale up or optical scale up?
native: There's a lot of conversation about is NVidia going to copper scale up or optical scale up?

en: We're going to do both.
zh: 我們將兩者都做。
ja: 私たちは両方を行います。
local: We're going to do both.

ja: 開発者は複数のAPIを通じて接続します。
local: Developers connect through several APIs.
native: Developers connect through several APIs.

en: DSX SIM, for physical, electrical, thermal, and network simulation.
zh: DSX SIM 用於物理、電氣、熱和網路模擬。
ja: DSX SIMは物理、電気、熱、ネットワークのシミュレーション用です。
local: DSX SIM, for physical, electrical, thermal, and network simulation.
native: DSX SIM, for physical, electrical, thermal, and network simulation.

en: DSX Exchange, for AI factory operational data.
zh: DSX Exchange 用於人工智慧工廠的運營數據。
ja: DSX ExchangeはAI工場の運用データ用です。
local: DSX Exchange, for AI factory operational data.
native: DSX Exchange, for AI factory operational data.

en: DSX Flex, for secure dynamic power management between the grid.
zh: DSX Flex 用於電網間的安全動態電力管理。
ja: DSX Flexは電力網間の安全な動的電力管理用です。
local: DSX Flex, for secure dynamic power management between the grid.
native: DSX Flex, for secure dynamic power management between the grid.

en: And DSX Max Q, to dynamically maximize token throughput.
zh: 以及 DSX Max Q，用於動態最大化代幣吞吐量。
ja: そしてDSX Max Qはトークンスループットを動的に最大化します。
local: And DSX Max Q, to dynamically maximize token throughput.
native: And DSX Max Q, to dynamically maximize token throughput.

en: It starts with SIM ready assets from NVIDIA and equipment manufacturers.
zh: 它從 NVIDIA 和設備製造商提供的 SIM 準備資產開始。
ja: NVIDIAと機器メーカーからのSIM準備済み資産から始まります。
local: It starts with SIM ready assets from NVIDIA and equipment manufacturers.
native: It starts with SIM ready assets from NVIDIA and equipment manufacturers.

en: Managed by PTC windshield PLM.
zh: 由 PTC Windshield PLM 管理。
ja: PTC Windshield PLMによって管理されます。
local: Managed by PTC windshield PLM.
native: Managed by PTC windshield PLM.

en: Then, model-based systems engineering is done in DASO Systems 3D experience.
zh: 接著，在 DASO Systems 3D 體驗中進行基於模型的系統工程。
ja: その後、DASO Systems 3Dエクスペリエンスでモデルベースのシステムエンジニアリングが行われます。
local: Then, model-based systems engineering is done in DASO Systems 3D experience.
native: Then, model-based systems engineering is done in DASO Systems 3D experience.

en: Jacob springs the data into their custom omnibus app to finalize design.
zh: Jacob 將資料導入他們的自訂綜合應用程式以完成設計。
ja: ジェイコブはデータをカスタムのオムニバスアプリに投入して設計を完成させます。
local: Jacob springs the data into their custom omnibus app to finalize design.
native: Jacob springs the data into their custom omnibus app to finalize design.

en: It's tested with leading simulation tools,
zh: 它使用領先的模擬工具進行測試，
ja: これは主要なシミュレーションツールでテストされます。
local: It's tested with leading simulation tools,
native: It's tested with leading simulation tools,

en: using Siemens Star CCM Plus for external thermals.
zh: 使用 Siemens Star CCM Plus 進行外部熱模擬。
ja: 外部熱解析にはSiemens Star CCM Plusを使用します。
local: using Siemens Star CCM Plus for external thermals.
native: using Siemens Star CCM Plus for external thermals.

en: Cadence reality for internal, E-Tap for electrical,
zh: 內部使用 Cadence Reality，電氣使用 E-Tap，
ja: 内部解析にはCadence Reality、電気解析にはE-Tapを使用します。
local: Cadence reality for internal, E-Tap for electrical,
native: Cadence reality for internal, E-Tap for electrical,

en: and NVIDIA's network simulator DSX Air.
zh: 以及 NVIDIA 的網路模擬器 DSX Air。
ja: そしてNVIDIAのネットワークシミュレーターDSX Airを使用します。
local: and NVIDIA's network simulator DSX Air.
native: and NVIDIA's network simulator DSX Air.

en: And virtually commission through Procore to ensure accelerated construction time.
zh: 並通過 Procore 進行虛擬調試，以確保加速施工時間。
ja: Procoreを通じて仮想的に委託し、建設時間の短縮を確保します。
local: And virtually commission through Procore to ensure accelerated construction time.
native: And virtually commission through Procore to ensure accelerated construction time.

en: When the site goes live, the digital twin becomes the operator.
zh: 當現場啟用時，數位孿生成為操作員。
ja: 現場が稼働すると、デジタルツインがオペレーターになります。
local: When the site goes live, the digital twin becomes the operator.
native: When the site goes live, the digital twin becomes the operator.

en: AI agents work with DSX Max Q to dynamically orchestrate infrastructure.
zh: 人工智慧代理與 DSX Max Q 合作，動態協調基礎設施。
ja: AIエージェントはDSX Max Qと連携してインフラを動的に調整します。
local: AI agents work with DSX Max Q to dynamically orchestrate infrastructure.
native: AI agents work with DSX Max Q to dynamically orchestrate infrastructure.

en: Fageless agent oversees cooling and electrical systems,
zh: Fageless 代理監督冷卻和電氣系統，
ja: Fagelessエージェントは冷却および電気システムを監督します。
local: Fageless agent oversees cooling and electrical systems,
native: Fageless agent oversees cooling and electrical systems,

en: sending signals to Max Q, which continuously optimizes compute throughput and energy efficiency.
zh: 向 Max Q 發送信號，持續優化計算吞吐量和能源效率。
ja: Max Qに信号を送り、計算スループットとエネルギー効率を継続的に最適化します。
local: sending signals to Max Q, which continuously optimizes compute throughput and energy efficiency.
native: sending signals to Max Q, which continuously optimizes compute throughput and energy efficiency.

en: Emerald AI agents interpret live grid demand and stress signals,
zh: Emerald AI 代理解讀即時電網需求和壓力信號，
ja: Emerald AIエージェントはリアルタイムの電力網需要とストレス信号を解釈します。
local: Emerald AI agents interpret live grid demand and stress signals,
native: Emerald AI agents interpret live grid demand and stress signals,

en: and adjust power dynamically.
zh: 並動態調整電力。
ja: そして電力を動的に調整します。
local: and adjust power dynamically.
native: and adjust power dynamically.

en: With DSX and NVIDIA and our ecosystem of partners,
zh: 有了 DSX、NVIDIA 以及我們的合作夥伴生態系，
ja: DSX、NVIDIA、そして私たちのパートナーエコシステムと共に、
local: With DSX and NVIDIA and our ecosystem of partners,
native: With DSX and NVIDIA and our ecosystem of partners,

en: are racing to build AI infrastructure around the world,
zh: 正競相在全球建造人工智慧基礎設施，
ja: 世界中でAIインフラを構築するために競争しています。
local: are racing to build AI infrastructure around the world,
native: are racing to build AI infrastructure around the world,

en: ensuring extreme resiliency, efficiency, and throughput.
zh: 確保極致的韌性、效率和吞吐量。
ja: 極限の耐障害性、効率性、スループットを確保しています。
local: ensuring extreme resiliency, efficiency, and throughput.
native: ensuring extreme resiliency, efficiency, and throughput.

en: It's incredible, right?
zh: 真是令人難以置信，對吧？
ja: すごいですよね？
local: It's incredible, right?
native: It's incredible, right?

en: Well, omnibus was designed to hold the world's digital twin,
zh: 嗯，Omnibus 被設計來承載世界的數位孿生，
ja: オムニバスは世界のデジタルツインを保持するために設計されました。
local: Well, omnibus was designed to hold the world's digital twin,
native: Well, omnibus was designed to hold the world's digital twin,

en: starting from the earth, and it's going to hold digital twins of all sizes.
zh: 從地球開始，它將承載各種規模的數位孿生。
ja: 地球から始まり、あらゆるサイズのデジタルツインを保持します。
local: starting from the earth, and it's going to hold digital twins of all sizes.
native: starting from the earth, and it's going to hold digital twins of all sizes.

en: And so we have such a great ecosystem of partners that want to thank all of you.
zh: 因此我們擁有如此優秀的合作夥伴生態系，感謝大家。
ja: 素晴らしいパートナーエコシステムがあり、皆さんに感謝したいです。
local: And so we have such a great ecosystem of partners that want to thank all of you.
native: And so we have such a great ecosystem of partners that want to thank all of you.

en: All of these companies are brand new to our world.
zh: 這些公司對我們的世界來說都是全新的。
ja: これらの会社は私たちの世界にとって全く新しい存在です。
local: All of these companies are brand new to our world.
native: All of these companies are brand new to our world.

en: We didn't know many of you just a couple of years ago.
zh: 幾年前我們還不認識你們中的許多人。
ja: 数年前には多くの皆さんを知りませんでした。
local: We didn't know many of you just a couple of years ago.
native: We didn't know many of you just a couple of years ago.

en: And now we're working so close together to work on and build together the largest computer
zh: 現在我們緊密合作，共同打造有史以來最大的電腦，
ja: そして今、私たちは密接に協力して史上最大のコンピューターを構築しています。
local: And now we're working so close together to work on and build together the largest computer
native: And now we're working so close together to work on and build together the largest computer

en: the world's ever seen and also to do it at planetary scale.
zh: 這是世界有史以來見過的，並且以行星規模進行。
ja: 世界でこれまでに見たことのない規模で、惑星規模で行っています。
local: the world's ever seen and also to do it at planetary scale.
native: the world's ever seen and also to do it at planetary scale.

en: So NVIDIA DSX is our new AI factory platform.
zh: 所以 NVIDIA DSX 是我們新的人工智慧工廠平台。
ja: だからNVIDIA DSXは私たちの新しいAI工場プラットフォームです。
local: So NVIDIA DSX is our new AI factory platform.
native: So NVIDIA DSX is our new AI factory platform.

en: I'll spend very little time on this this time.
zh: 這次我會很少談論這個。
ja: 今回はこれについてあまり時間をかけません。
local: I'll spend very little time on this this time.
native: I'll spend very little time on this this time.

en: However, we're going to space.
zh: 不過，我們正要進入太空。
ja: しかし、私たちは宇宙に向かっています。
local: However, we're going to space.
native: However, we're going to space.

en: We've already been out in space.
zh: 我們已經進入太空了。
ja: すでに宇宙に出ています。
local: We've already been out in space.
native: We've already been out in space.

en: Thor is radiation approved.
zh: Thor 已通過輻射認證。
ja: Thorは放射線認証を受けています。
local: Thor is radiation approved.
native: Thor is radiation approved.

en: We're in satellites. You do imaging from satellites in the future.
zh: 我們在衛星領域。未來你可以從衛星進行影像拍攝。
ja: 私たちは衛星にいます。将来的には衛星からのイメージングを行います。
local: We're in satellites. You do imaging from satellites in the future.
native: We're in satellites. You do imaging from satellites in the future.

en: We'll also build data centers in space.
zh: 我們也將在太空中建造資料中心。
ja: 宇宙にデータセンターも建設します。
local: We'll also build data centers in space.
native: We'll also build data centers in space.

en: Obviously, very complicated to do so.
zh: 顯然，這非常複雜。
ja: もちろん、それは非常に複雑です。
local: Obviously, very complicated to do so.
native: Obviously, very complicated to do so.

en: We're working with our partners on a new computer called Vera Rubin Space One.
zh: 我們與合作夥伴合作開發一款名為 Vera Rubin Space One 的新電腦。
ja: 私たちはパートナーと協力してVera Rubin Space Oneという新しいコンピューターを開発しています。
local: We're working with our partners on a new computer called Vera Rubin Space One.
native: We're working with our partners on a new computer called Vera Rubin Space One.

en: And it's going to go out to space and start data centers out out in space.
zh: 它將進入太空並在太空中啟動資料中心。
ja: それは宇宙に行き、宇宙でデータセンターを開始します。
local: And it's going to go out to space and start data centers out out in space.
native: And it's going to go out to space and start data centers out out in space.

en: Now, of course, in space, there's no conduction.
zh: 當然，在太空中沒有傳導。
ja: もちろん、宇宙には伝導がありません。
local: Now, of course, in space, there's no conduction.
native: Now, of course, in space, there's no conduction.

en: There's no convection. There's just radiation.
zh: 沒有對流，只有輻射。
ja: 対流もなく、放射だけです。
local: There's no convection. There's just radiation.
native: There's no convection. There's just radiation.

en: So we have to figure out how to cool these systems out in space.
zh: 所以我們必須想辦法在太空中冷卻這些系統。
ja: だから宇宙でこれらのシステムを冷却する方法を考えなければなりません。
local: So we have to figure out how to cool these systems out in space.
native: So we have to figure out how to cool these systems out in space.

en: But we've got lots of great engineers working on it.
zh: 但我們有很多優秀的工程師在努力。
ja: しかし、多くの優秀なエンジニアが取り組んでいます。
local: But we've got lots of great engineers working on it.
native: But we've got lots of great engineers working on it.

en: Let me talk to you about something new.
zh: 讓我跟你談談一些新東西。
ja: 新しいことについて話しましょう。
local: Let me talk to you about something new.
native: Let me talk to you about something new.

en: So Peter Steinberger is here.
zh: 所以 Peter Steinberger 在這裡。
ja: ピーター・スタインバーガーがここにいます。
local: So Peter Steinberger is here.
native: So Peter Steinberger is here.

en: He wrote a piece of software. It's called Open Claw.
zh: 他寫了一個軟體，叫做 Open Claw。
ja: 彼はOpen Clawというソフトウェアを書きました。
local: He wrote a piece of software. It's called Open Claw.
native: He wrote a piece of software. It's called Open Claw.

en: And I don't know if he realized how successful it's going to be.
zh: 我不知道他是否意識到它會有多成功。
ja: 彼がそれがどれほど成功するか気づいているかはわかりません。
local: And I don't know if he realized how successful it's going to be.
native: And I don't know if he realized how successful it's going to be.

en: But the importance is profound.
zh: 但其重要性深遠。
ja: しかし、その重要性は非常に大きいです。
local: But the importance is profound.
native: But the importance is profound.

en: Open Claw is the number one.
zh: Open Claw 是第一名。
ja: Open Clawはナンバーワンです。
local: Open Claw is the number one.
native: Open Claw is the number one.

en: It's the most popular open source project in the history of humanity.
zh: 它是人類歷史上最受歡迎的開源專案。
ja: それは人類史上最も人気のあるオープンソースプロジェクトです。
local: It's the most popular open source project in the history of humanity.
native: It's the most popular open source project in the history of humanity.

en: And it did so in just a few weeks.
zh: 而且只用了幾週時間。
ja: そしてわずか数週間で達成しました。
local: And it did so in just a few weeks.
native: And it did so in just a few weeks.

en: It exceeded what Linux did in 30 years.
zh: 它超越了 Linux 30 年的成就。
ja: それはLinuxが30年かけて成し遂げたことを超えました。
local: It exceeded what Linux did in 30 years.
native: It exceeded what Linux did in 30 years.

en: And it's that important. It is that important.
zh: 它就是那麼重要。真的那麼重要。
ja: それほど重要なのです。本当にそれほど重要です。
local: And it's that important. It is that important.
native: And it's that important. It is that important.

en: It will do well.
zh: 它會做得很好。
ja: それはうまくいくでしょう。
local: It will do well.
native: It will do well.

en: This is all you do.
zh: 這就是你要做的全部。
ja: これがあなたがすることのすべてです。
local: This is all you do.
native: This is all you do.

en: We're announcing our support of it.
zh: 我們宣布支持它。
ja: 私たちはそれをサポートすることを発表します。
local: We're announcing our support of it.
native: We're announcing our support of it.

en: Let me just quickly go through this.
zh: 讓我快速說明一下。
ja: これを簡単に説明させてください。
local: Let me just quickly go through this.
native: Let me just quickly go through this.

en: I want to show you a couple of things.
zh: 我想展示幾件事給你看。
ja: いくつかのことをお見せしたいです。
local: I want to show you a couple of things.
native: I want to show you a couple of things.

en: You simply type this into a console.
zh: 你只需在控制台輸入這個。
ja: これをコンソールに入力するだけです。
local: You simply type this into a console.
native: You simply type this into a console.

en: And it goes out. It finds Open Claw.
zh: 它會自動去尋找 Open Claw。
ja: それが外に出てOpen Clawを見つけます。
local: And it goes out. It finds Open Claw.
native: And it goes out. It finds Open Claw.

en: It downloads it. It builds you an AI agent.
zh: 它下載它，為你建立一個人工智慧代理。
ja: それをダウンロードし、AIエージェントを構築します。
local: It downloads it. It builds you an AI agent.
native: It downloads it. It builds you an AI agent.

en: And then you could tell it whatever else you need to do.
zh: 然後你可以告訴它你還需要做什麼。
ja: そして、必要なことを何でも指示できます。
local: And then you could tell it whatever else you need to do.
native: And then you could tell it whatever else you need to do.

en: So let's take a look.
zh: 那麼我們來看看。
ja: では見てみましょう。
local: So let's take a look.
native: So let's take a look.

en: The Open Source Project just dropped.
zh: 開源專案剛剛發布。
ja: オープンソースプロジェクトが公開されました。
local: The Open Source Project just dropped.
native: The Open Source Project just dropped.

en: Andre Carpathian just launched something called the research is a huge deal.
zh: Andre Carpathian 剛推出了一個名為 research 的重要項目。
ja: アンドレ・カーパシアンが「research」という大きなプロジェクトを立ち上げました。
local: Andre Carpathian just launched something called the research is a huge deal.
native: Andre Carpathian just launched something called the research is a huge deal.

en: We give an AI agent a task. Go to sleep.
zh: 我們給人工智慧代理一個任務：去睡覺。
ja: AIエージェントに「休止する」というタスクを与えます。
local: We give an AI agent a task. Go to sleep.
native: We give an AI agent a task. Go to sleep.

en: It runs a hundred experiments overnight.
zh: 它在一夜之間進行一百次實驗。
ja: それは一晩で100の実験を行います。
local: It runs a hundred experiments overnight.
native: It runs a hundred experiments overnight.

en: Keeping what works and killing what doesn't.
zh: 保留有效的，淘汰無效的。
ja: うまくいくものを残し、うまくいかないものを排除します。
local: Keeping what works and killing what doesn't.
native: Keeping what works and killing what doesn't.

en: And we love what my stuff enables that person to do.
zh: 我們喜歡我的技術讓那個人能做到的事情。
ja: そして私の技術がその人にできることを私たちは愛しています。
local: And we love what my stuff enables that person to do.
native: And we love what my stuff enables that person to do.

en: And we had like one guy. He told me like install it at a 60-year-old dad.
zh: 我們有一個人，他告訴我像是安裝在一個60歲的爸爸身上。
ja: ある男性がいて、彼は60歳の父親にインストールするように言いました。
local: And we had like one guy. He told me like install it at a 60-year-old dad.
ja_pron: Aru dansei ga ite, kare wa rokujussai no chichioya ni insutōru suru yō ni iimashita.
native: And we had like one guy. He told me like install it at a 60-year-old dad.

en: And like they made gear.
zh: 他們還製作了裝備。
ja: そして彼らはギアを作りました。
local: And like they made gear.
ja_pron: Soshite karera wa gia o tsukurimashita.
native: And like they made gear.

en: Connected the machine via Bluetooth to Open Claw.
zh: 透過藍牙將機器連接到 Open Claw。
ja: 機械をBluetoothでOpen Clawに接続しました。
local: Connected the machine via Bluetooth to Open Claw.
ja_pron: Kikai o Bluetooth de Open Claw ni setsuzoku shimashita.
native: Connected the machine via Bluetooth to Open Claw.

en: And then we automate everything including the whole website for people to order.
zh: 然後我們自動化所有事情，包括整個網站讓人們下訂單。
ja: そして、人々が注文できるようにウェブサイト全体を含めてすべてを自動化しました。
local: And then we automate everything including the whole website for people to order.
ja_pron: Soshite, hitobito ga chūmon dekiru yō ni u~ebusaito zentai o fukume subete o jidōka shimashita.
native: And then we automate everything including the whole website for people to order.

en: Lops to luck. I feel tick same.
zh: Lops to luck。我感覺一樣。
ja: Lops to luck。私は同じように感じます。
local: Lops to luck. I feel tick same.
ja_pron: Lops to luck. Watashi wa onaji yō ni kanjimasu.
native: Lops to luck. I feel tick same.

en: Hundreds of people are queuing up for Lops to skin.
zh: 數百人正在排隊等待 Lops to skin。
ja: 何百人もの人がLops to skinのために列を作っています。
local: Hundreds of people are queuing up for Lops to skin.
ja_pron: Nanbyakunin mo no hito ga Lops to skin no tame ni retsu o tsukutteimasu.
native: Hundreds of people are queuing up for Lops to skin.

en: So Jen.
zh: 所以 Jen。
ja: それで、ジェン。
local: So Jen.
ja_pron: Sorede, Jen.
native: So Jen.

en: Open Claw.
zh: Open Claw。
ja: Open Claw。
local: Open Claw.
ja_pron: Open Claw.
native: Open Claw.

en: Open Claw.
zh: Open Claw。
ja: Open Claw。
local: Open Claw.
ja_pron: Open Claw.
native: Open Claw.

en: Open Claw.
zh: Open Claw。
ja: Open Claw。
local: Open Claw.
ja_pron: Open Claw.
native: Open Claw.
